title: a_short_regime_comparison_weekly
description: One weekly comparison-only record for the V14.3 regime classifier (design slice 2): the V14.2 production regime label vs the V14.3 raw regime label for an as_of, with the divergence flag and the forward 1/3/5/10-trading-day returns measured on the const-pinned forward_return_basis (null until the horizon has elapsed, then backfilled by a later run — NEVER fabricated). NON-production / comparison-only: V14.2 stays the frozen production baseline; this record does NOT drive Phase 5 risk posture, overlay stars, or M6.7 actions. It accumulates the switch-decision evidence clock. Field-local constraints are pinned here; cross-field invariants (divergence == (v14_2 != v14_3_raw), pending == exactly the null horizons, backfill_complete == empty pending, fired_rule consistent with regime) are enforced by engine.a_short_regime_classifier.validate_comparison_record, which JSON Schema cannot express.

v14_2_regime.description: the production V14.2 M1 regime label as surfaced this run (mirrors analysis_input market_regime.status enum; often 'unknown' — V14.2 M1 is not always computed)

v14_3_fired_rule.description: the winning rule key; must be a rule of v14_3_raw_regime (cross-checked by validate_comparison_record)

forward_returns.description: forward return per horizon on forward_return_basis; null = horizon not yet elapsed (backfilled later, never look-ahead)

forward_returns_pending.description: horizons still null/awaiting backfill; must equal exactly the null horizons (validate_comparison_record)

forward_return_basis.description: const-pinned so every record declares one unambiguous return basis; no mixing raw/excess, decimal/percent, or gross/cost across records.
